note.en: interval: extra delay after each step, 0–60000 ms. loop: 1–10000 or -1 for infinite. T=0 exits the loop.

note.en: Distinct id/new_id integers in 0–253; connect devices individually. Verifies the new ID. Shared by encoders and steppers.

note.zh: mode=0 位置、1 连续转动、2 从动。mode=2 必须提供 leader_id（从 ID，0–253，与本机主 ID 不同），其值与被跟随设备 ID 相同。模式写入关闭输出；0/1 切换无需重启。
note.en: mode=0 position, 1 velocity, 2 follower. Mode 2 requires leader_id (secondary ID, 0–253, distinct from own primary ID) matching the leader. Mode writes disable output; switching 0/1 needs no restart.

note.zh: 按示例字段设置参数；执行前确认目标设备和供电。
note.en: Set fields as shown; verify target hardware and power before execution.

note.zh: 按示例字段设置参数；执行前确认目标设备和供电。
note.en: Set fields as shown; verify target hardware and power before execution.

note.zh: pos=0–65534，speed=1–32767，acc=0–254，current=0–1000。原始寄存器单位，current 不是安培。需先设位置模式并使能。
note.en: pos=0–65534, speed=1–32767, acc=0–254, current=0–1000. Register units; current is not amperes. Set position mode and enable first.

note.zh: speed=-32767–32767，0 停止；acc=0–254，current=0–1000。先设连续模式并使能。
note.en: speed=-32767–32767, 0 stops; acc=0–254, current=0–1000. Set velocity mode and enable first.

note.zh: enable=0 失能，1 使能。
note.en: enable=0 disables output, 1 enables it.

note.zh: pos=0–65534；当前位置基准写入设备，不产生运动。
note.en: pos=0–65534; saves current position reference without motion.

note.zh: 返回 pos/speed；每圈 4096 计数，多圈位置 0–65534，掉电不保留累计圈数。
note.en: Returns pos/speed; 4096 counts/turn, multi-turn position 0–65534. Accumulated turns do not survive power loss.

note.zh: 按示例字段设置参数；执行前确认目标设备和供电。
note.en: Set fields as shown; verify target hardware and power before execution.

note.zh: id/new_id 为不同的 0–253 整数。逐个接入，拒绝已占用 ID；解锁、写入、读回并重新锁定。失败后先扫描，不自动重试。
note.en: Distinct id/new_id integers 0–253. Connect individually; occupied IDs rejected. Unlock, write, read back and relock. Scan after failure; no automatic retries.

note.zh: id=0–253；返回 accel_raw/gyro_raw（符号幅值解码，原始计数）、quaternion_xyzw（半精度解码，W 取非负根）。SDK 未提供物理单位映射或采样计数。六轴航向会漂移。
note.en: id=0–253; accel_raw/gyro_raw are signed-magnitude decoded raw counts; quaternion_xyzw decodes half floats and reconstructs nonnegative W. SDK supplies no physical-unit mapping or sample counter. Six-axis heading drifts.
